body:
REVIEW-C of 064. This seat did not write it. QUESTIONABLE inputs. PROJECTION payloads. No qualified hull safety factor. No demonstrated mismatch, so no fix row.

Independent simjob simjob-20261020t172053-1b07079aefe4 exited 0 in 78 s on this seat's copy of the 063 model. 064's driver was not run. All eight cells at gamma 0.20 reproduce: factors, payloads, Vc, and the binding mode. The largest closure-density difference is 0.00012 kg/m3. Every concept and TRL 7 payload is negative. At Q 0.82, R 30 ISA is factor 1.4949, concept -40,183 kg, TRL 7 -24,952 kg, closure 1,238 kg/m3. At Q 0.33 it is 2.0802, -97,878 kg, -77,634 kg, and 889 kg/m3. Specific modulus at 293.6 GPa is 159 at 1,850 kg/m3, 237 at the first closure, and 330 at the second.

CR-1457 section 6.2 reproduces: two hemisphere points, six ellipsoidal, gamma 0.20, ellipsoid 0.35, gamma 1 at Vc at least 2, and no continuous ramp. Reference 6-4 is the 55-inch title. The two DOIs are not sphere tests. The 2014-T6 glass-fabric sentence is a flight-bulkhead account. SDL 468 was not opened, so the specimen alloy is unchecked. SP-8032, the Lee series, and the 2024 note were not reopened.

A published gamma of 0.20 closes no cell. Stopping.
